people.name: Founder
people.bio: CPE was founded in 2007 with a simple conviction: disciplined teaching and genuine care can transform a student's future. Every classroom we run is built on that belief.

people.name: Management
people.bio: Our management works closely with faculty and parents to keep academic standards high, infrastructure reliable and student welfare at the centre of every decision.

people.name: Principal
people.bio: We focus on strong fundamentals, consistent mentoring and career awareness from the first year itself, so that students step into competitive examinations with confidence.
